name: Phobos 2
tagline: Last Soviet planetary mission; lost at Phobos approach
description: The last Soviet planetary mission. Reached Mars orbit in January 1989 but lost contact with Earth on March 27, 1989, just before its planned encounter with the moon Phobos. Phobos 2 returned 37 images of Phobos before contact was lost. The loss was attributed to an on-board computer failure causing loss of attitude control and power, though the complete sequence was never fully reconstructed.
best_known_for: Last Soviet planetary mission; lost at Phobos approach
